description: Source code for an IO timer source class that manages timer file descriptors, starts/stops timer ticking, and handles timer expiration events within a larger software system.

classes.name: io_timer_source
classes.description: Class managing a timer file descriptor, starting/stopping timer ticks, and handling timer expiration events.

methods.name: create_timer_fd
methods.description: Creates and configures a timer file descriptor with specified tick period.

methods.name: io_timer_source::io_timer_source
methods.description: Constructor initializing the timer source with parameters and optionally auto-start.

methods.name: io_timer_source::~io_timer_source
methods.description: Destructor that requests stopping the timer and cleans up.

methods.name: io_timer_source::resume
methods.description: Starts the timer ticking if not already running.

methods.name: io_timer_source::request_stop
methods.description: Requests to stop the timer asynchronously.

methods.name: io_timer_source::create_subscriber
methods.description: Creates and registers the timer file descriptor with the broker.

methods.name: io_timer_source::destroy_subscriber
methods.description: Unregisters and destroys the timer file descriptor.

methods.name: io_timer_source::read_time
methods.description: Handles timer expiration events by reading timerfd and invoking tick sink.
